model 0.55-0.8 with reasons; rule scorer near-flat; model kept

note.text: 1400 smoke: no page errors; screenshot Temp/done-1400.png in worktree. Fresh-agent docs check skipped to save tokens.

findings.text: At 400 the Refine toolbar crushes: the Model select is an empty box with no visible choice, the Mic/Level/Whisper/Transcript/Refine status row is cut off at the right edge (only Mic and Level show), and the textarea placeholder is clipped (wrapping 23, layout 3): shots/…-ext-Refine/400.png, top band.

The links under the workspace run together with no separators: "Saved long run (ladder)Compare models (try)How it fits (architecture)" (words 5, page 8): shots/…-ext-Refine/1920.png, band after the footer.

Ask 2 says "test Haiku 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5 … record the numbers"; `doc/refine-v3-2026-10-09.md` says Sonnet was faster but records no Haiku-vs-Sonnet times or costs for the 125 words: the comparison is a claim, not a measurement.

Ask 5 wants the instance explorer beside or merged with the stages, "updating as the owner dictates"; it is folded shut in a `<details>` in the sticky footer, so in every shot it is a single closed button and the counts and tree are never visible (page 9, words 1): shots/…-ext-Refine/1920.png, footer band.
`RefineSystem.go()` counts words with `text.split(/s+/)` (splits on the letter "s", not whitespace), so `history[].words` is wrong for every prompt: diff, `RefineSystem.js` go().

The working message hard-codes "usually about 8 s and about 3 cents"; the doc measures $0.003–0.0075 per call and a cold run at $0.57, and one refine now makes 2 + one-per-sentence calls. Show the estimate from the last measured run, or drop the cost figure.
The "refinement disappeared" bug was not reproduced; a guard was added (`quick()` never overwrites a finished prompt). The doc says so honestly; it stays open.
Literal colours in new CSS: `orange`, `seagreen`, `crimson` in `Whisper.css`, `var(--paper, #fff)` in `Prompt.css` (colour 3).

`Prompt.css` patches itself: `.refine-prompt` is declared twice in one layer, and a second `@layer site` block re-overrides `.refine-toolbar` and its textarea set three lines above (css 42). Fold into one rule each.

The Whisper page shows a bare instance with status "unknown" and 0 sessions, one narrow column on an empty 1920 screen; Whisper is also missing from the audio Overview's class cards (MicStream, Recorder, Transcriber only): shots/…-audio-Whisper/1920.png, shots/…-audio/1200.png.
The Whisper server model is not shown (the brief asked for it); the doc says the server does not report it. Replay timeline (bonus) not built, also stated.
